observations.behavior: Adds an explicit error throw when authentication is not ready instead of silently returning empty results.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the Desktop app's session service to fail loudly rather than suppress downloads; could help users notice auth failures.

observations.behavior: Computes a deterministic key from visible file names and uses it in store state and re-render triggers. This makes UI behavior depend on actual content changes rather than just task ID or user interaction.
observations.posthog_connection: Could make CloudArtifactDownloads more responsive to backend updates, potentially improving perceived reliability for desktop users viewing shared sessions.

observations.behavior: Adds a new action that explicitly resets collapse state when the file list representation changes, while preserving other stored preferences.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a mechanism to reset collapsed state without clearing broader per-task settings, which could reduce unexpected UI jumps during live collaboration.

observations.limitations: All hunks are confined to the Desktop package and its tests; no server-side implementation, API compatibility checks, or end-to-end integration with PostHog’s warehouse or event ingestion paths is shown. The tier cannot rely solely on these client-only observations.

review.posthog_relevance: Relevant as a potential quality-of-life and correctness enhancement for Desktop users interacting with cloud artifacts, though adoption and benefit depend on deployment and actual usage patterns.
